title: 'I'd now recommend updating it to: read The Lean Startup and Incorruptible'
summary: Peter Trizuliak — Goodreads reader and active reviewer — proposes updating the canonical startup-founder reading recommendation from The Lean Startup alone to The Lean Startup plus Incorruptible. Adds the book to his re-read shelf.
blockquote: The typical advice for startup founders was: "read The Lean Startup" I'd now recommend updating it to "read The Lean Startup and Incorruptible". 6 stars from me and added to re-read shelf as well. I do really hope that this book spreads not only through tech industry, but pretty much everyone who's still part of active workforce. There's still time to stir the ship.
